## Goal

Define the storage rules every new store follows: a cap table, insert-time eviction, windowed readers returning items, total and truncated, single-oversized-row refusal, and a static budget proof under 32 MiB.

- Store contract document and API
- Contract tests

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-CONTRACT-602-01` — A contract document and Swift API cover the capacity ring, change journal, object index, review reports and sessions with their caps from the design; the static check proves sum(cap x maximum row bytes) is at most 32 MiB.
- `AC-CONTRACT-602-02` — Contract tests: inserting cap + 1 rows keeps the count at cap; every reader at cap answers under the 1 MiB response ceiling; a reader never refuses a whole result for row count.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-CONTRACT-602-01` (contract-test) — Contract tests and the static budget check, with a mutation red that removes write-time eviction.
